infectious.name: Infectious Disease Rapid Tests
infectious.overview: Lateral-flow tests for the high-burden infections that clinics and public-health programs screen daily — dengue, malaria, HIV, hepatitis, H. pylori, syphilis, respiratory and tropical pathogens.
sub_categories: Bacterial (H. pylori, Strep A, cholera, typhoid)
infectious.buyer_angle: Distributors, NGOs, government tenders and aid programs — combined panels, CE-marked lines, tropical/remote distribution (room-temperature stable).

doa.name: Drug of Abuse (DOA) Rapid Tests
doa.overview: The most complete drug-testing line — 400+ SKUs from single-analyte dipsticks to integrated 14-panel screening cups, for workplace, clinical and rehabilitation screening.
sub_categories: Single analyte (THC, COC, AMP, MET, MOP/OPI, BZO, fentanyl…)
doa.buyer_angle: Workplace screening programs, occupational health and clinical toxicology — SAMHSA-style cut-offs, CE-marked lines (FDA status per product on request), private-label custom panels.

cardiac-tumor.name: Cardiac & Tumor Marker Rapid Tests
cardiac-tumor.overview: Point-of-care cardiac biomarkers (troponin, CK-MB, myoglobin, D-dimer, CRP, PCT, SAA) and tumor markers (PSA, AFP, CEA) for triage and monitoring.
sub_categories: Cardiac injury (troponin I/T, CK-MB, myoglobin, H-FABP)
cardiac-tumor.buyer_angle: Hospitals, laboratories and clinics — triage-grade POC assays with fluorescence quantitative formats available.

womens-health.name: Women's Health Rapid Tests
womens-health.overview: Pregnancy and fertility hormone tests — hCG, LH, FSH, fFN, iGFBP-1 — for clinics, retail and home use.
womens-health.buyer_angle: Clinics, pharmacy retail and distributors — high-volume, CE-marked lines (FDA status per product on request).

other.name: Other Rapid Tests
other.overview: High-turnover specialty assays — H. pylori, CRP, mononucleosis, occult blood, ferritin, HbA1c, vitamin D — for primary care and pharmacy.
other.buyer_angle: Primary care and pharmacy — low-MOQ, mixed-format catalog fill.

veterinary.name: Veterinary Diagnostic Tests
veterinary.overview: Point-of-care tests for companion animals and livestock — canine, feline and bovine — built on the same lateral-flow platform as human diagnostics.
veterinary.buyer_angle: Animal-health distributors and clinics — instrument-free, whole-blood/serum/fecal formats, OEM/private label. Catalog on request (line actively expanding).

urine-analysis.name: Urine Analysis Reagent Strips
urine-analysis.overview: Multi-parameter urinalysis reagent strips (up to 10 parameters) for clinics, laboratories and retail pharmacy.
urine-analysis.buyer_angle: Clinics, labs and retail — private-label strips, custom parameter sets, bulk supply. Catalog on request.

fia.name: Fluorescence Immunoassay (FIA)
fia.overview: Quantitative rapid tests read by a fluorescence analyzer — upgrading from qualitative triage to numeric results.
fia.buyer_angle: Hospitals and labs needing quantitative POC results — paired with the AFR fluorescence analyzer. Catalog on request.

lfia-reader.name: LFIA Reader
lfia-reader.overview: A portable lateral-flow reader that reports objective intensity or semi-quantitative values, removing visual-read subjectivity.
lfia-reader.buyer_angle: Clinics needing objective readout — compatible with colloidal-gold and fluorescence cassettes; OEM/private label. Specifications on request.

urine-analyzer.name: Urine Analyzer (AUR)
urine-analyzer.overview: Automated urine analyzer for our multi-parameter reagent strips.
urine-analyzer.buyer_angle: Labs and clinics automating urinalysis — specifications and compatibility on request.

reader-analyzer.name: Reader Analyzer (ATR)
reader-analyzer.overview: Lateral-flow cassette reader analyzer for objective strip interpretation.
reader-analyzer.buyer_angle: Instrument for LFIA cassettes — specifications on request.

fluorescence-analyzer.name: Fluorescence Analyzer (AFR)
fluorescence-analyzer.overview: Fluorescence analyzer for FIA quantitative tests.
fluorescence-analyzer.buyer_angle: Instrument paired with FIA quantitative lines — specifications on request.
